title: A janitor quietly left $8 million
caption:
Ronald Read worked at a gas station and as a janitor in Vermont.
He lived simply and bought shares of solid companies, then held them for decades.
When he died in 2014, his estate was worth about eight million dollars.
He left about six million to his local library and hospital.
sources: The Wall Street Journal and Brattleboro Reformer reports on Ronald Read's estate (2015)
